datasets.name: Landslide dataset of Bijie
datasets.verbatim: Ji et al. [16] published the landslide dataset of Bijie that can be downloaded.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 images of Taiwan
datasets.verbatim: We used Google Earth Engine to download Sentinel-2 images of Taiwan from January 2022 to January 2023.

datasets.name: Ground truth dataset of landslides in Taiwan
datasets.verbatim: We produced 630 landslides across Taiwan (see Fig. 3) by the visual interpretation from the Sentinel-2 mosaic image. These landslides were taken as the ground truth to validate the transferability of the presented method.

methods.name: LA-YOLO-LLL (Lightweight Attention-Guided YOLO with Level Set Layer)
methods.summary: A landslide detection model that replaces the YOLO backbone with MobileNetv3, incorporates a custom 'light pyramid features reuse fusion' (LPFRF) attention mechanism, and integrates a level set layer into the YOLO head to refine bounding boxes into accurate landslide boundaries.
methods.source: Yueheng Yang, Zelang Miao, Hua Zhang, Bing Wang, and Lixin Wu

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the Sentinel-2 imagery is accessible via Google Earth Engine. The custom code for the LA-YOLO-LLL method is not available.
